designationHistory.indexText: Franklin Island National Wildlife Refuge, a 12-acre island off Friendship, Maine, was established in 1973 when the Coast Guard transferred the island to the Fish and Wildlife Service.
designationHistory.note: Both FWS; year only. The Coast Guard kept the lighthouse.
